newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi stocks seen lower on depressed sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Karachi stocks seen lower on depressed sentiment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are seen opening mixed on Wednesday on depressed sentiment due to political uncertainty before the February 3 general election and sectarian violence in Lahore and Multan, dealers said.
The sentiment was likely to spark selling pressure resulting in easing of stock prices, dealer Ali Raza said.
"There is no good news to cheer up the market sentiment," Raza said. On Tuesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 3.75 points, or 0.28 percent, down at 1,339.93.
